scope: New m=0 external (21,20), intermediate j=29..36, B=27 to T=65, lambda^2 DtN coefficient. The band certificate itself contains numerical error only.

independent_scientific_code_review.normalization: The unchanged Coulomb Taylor kernel returns H_j^+(r)/H_j^+(27), with d_r H in the initial derivative. External factors equal one at B.
independent_scientific_code_review.terminal_condition: Each new q_ab starts at exact zero at T=65; q_ab'=-F_a F_b V_ab. The original analytic K is retained across the terminal complex disk.
independent_scientific_code_review.coefficient: Sum j=29..36 of integral_B^T q_21j q_20j/F_j^2 dr. The code uses ordinary complex multiplication without conjugation and no extra factor 2.
independent_scientific_code_review.old_integration_exclusion: The mode loop is request.intermediate_modes and pairs are generated only for this band. PHYS68 run_profiles and its full-mode build_panel are not called. Evaluating external modes 20 and 21 is necessary for the new pair kernels and does not add them to the intermediate sum.
independent_scientific_code_review.same_equation_as_proof: INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md, actual DtN coefficient and disjoint-band addition sections.
independent_scientific_code_review.fixed_physics: Atomic B=27, k=7/10, E=49/200 Hartree, shift=7/10, original V=2(1+1/d)exp(-2d), Coulomb eta_C=-10/7, Z=+u'(B)u(B)^-1.

independent_error_propagation_review.unchanged_kernels: Outgoing Coulomb Arb point enclosures, ODE Taylor coefficients/majorants, algebraic angular Taylor coefficient enclosures, exact-weight polynomial integral, Cauchy remainder and L1 radius extraction are reused without source changes.
independent_error_propagation_review.q_center_error: The right-boundary enclosure is added to integral_0^h K_N and inflated by h times the large-disk Cauchy K remainder.
independent_error_propagation_review.q_left_error: The same right-boundary enclosure plus integral_-h^h K_N is inflated by 2h times that remainder.
independent_error_propagation_review.small_disk_q_majorant: |q_right|+(rho+h) M_K(rho) controls the analytic primitive on the rho disk.
independent_error_propagation_review.reciprocal_control: Every required Coulomb disk must have a strictly positive zero_free_lower(rho). The integrand majorant divides by its squared lower bound only after this gate.
independent_error_propagation_review.second_Born_integral_error: The exact degree-N series integral is inflated by 2h times M_integrand*(h/rho)^(N+1)/(1-h/rho). Arb propagates coefficient, denominator, boundary-carry and arithmetic roundoff.
independent_error_propagation_review.final_radius: Exact dyadic real and imaginary radii are added as a complex L1 absolute bound about the stored rectangular midpoint.
independent_error_propagation_review.radial_and_angular_tail_inclusion: Both are explicitly false in the finite-T band certificate. The separate assembler must use old numerical + band numerical + one full-L36 beta2(Gamma64,T65) + all-radial j>36 tail.

execution_and_resume_review.identity: Exact request/source/engine/runtime fingerprint; fixed band source and CLI hashes plus unchanged PHYS68 kernels and process-wrapper hash.
execution_and_resume_review.checkpoint: Atomic JSON replacement, payload hash, ordered index/center, all band and Coulomb modes, exact pair coverage, and immutable predecessor serialization hash.
execution_and_resume_review.carry: Consumed q_right must contain the predecessor's exact serialized q_left box. This preserves the PHYS68 correction for outward Arb magnitude decoding.
execution_and_resume_review.parser: New decoder rejects bool/float dyadic mantissas and exponents before the inherited decoder and rejects negative radii.
execution_and_resume_review.completion: Partial checkpoints omit the final D2 certificate. A complete valid enclosure that misses the goal has a distinct non-goal status.
execution_and_resume_review.wrapper: A bounded owned child with a campaign lock, explicit wall limit, optional Linux memory cap, one BLAS thread and an appended current-child invocation receipt. An old success is insufficient.
execution_and_resume_review.scope_limit: The lock guarantees exclusion for the same fingerprint; direct worker/function calls are internal and do not add a separate global locking contract.

reused_actual_test_evidence.coverage_read: Independent constant analytic integral, complex bilinear sign/factor, exact selected modes, failure on zero-free gate, missing pair, restart reuse without recomputation, corruption/carry rejection, exact-input rejection, requested-goal status, and current-child wrapper receipt.

independent_old_kernel_binding_check.actual_check: Canonical SHA256 of old REQUEST.binding equals the pinned old certificate fingerprint, and its binding.engine equals the band's phys68_reused_engine exactly. The old engine is stored in REQUEST.json, not in the old CERTIFICATE.json.

non_scientific_documentation_finding.required_handoff: Use the read-only assembler/verifier on this already completed result. Reserve the solver resume command for a genuinely incomplete campaign. No numerical source change or repeated integration is needed.
